'''Sty''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. Along with the rest of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], it lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] occupied the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Darlo/Legends|Darlo]] and had fifty-five [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sty was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA" />
